bundle.shortDescription: Offline TOTP authenticator with encrypted local vault
bundle.longDescription: VaultOTP is a fully offline, cross-platform desktop TOTP authenticator. Your 2FA secrets are encrypted with Argon2id + AES-256-GCM and stored in a local vault — nothing is ever synced, uploaded, or phoned home. Secrets never cross the IPC boundary into the UI; all key derivation, decryption, and code generation happen exclusively in the Rust backend.
